card.name: Words before 'per' or 'a' in rates
card.fires_on: The word 'once' or the hyphenated '-a' in 'once-a-week', and 'miles' or '/' in rates, right before a unit of time like day, week, month, hour or minute.

modes.label: Rates per time unit
modes.description: A word or slash in a speed or heart-rate expression, just before a time unit.

card.writes: It makes a time unit such as 'hour' more likely next and makes a slash-style unit like '/s' less likely.
card.plain: It fires on the spot in a dose or rate where a time period such as day, week or hour is about to follow.
